title: MongoDB
description:
MongoDB: aggregation pipelines, commands and the current operations. Needs
`make it-up` (port 17017). See `:help dbdash-databases`.

show.title: $documents, $match on an argument, flatten (shop.city)
show.description:
`$documents` makes rows in the pipeline, `$match` filters them by the `region`
argument (`| tojson` writes it as JSON), and `flatten: 1` turns `shop.city` and
`shop.size` into columns.

show.title: $group
show.description: `$group` sums `n` per region; the pie shows the totals.

query.transform:
-- rs.columns are the names, rs.rows[1] the one reply document.
local s = rs.rows[1]
local get = function(name)
  for i, c in ipairs(rs.columns) do if c == name then return s[i] end end
end
local conn = get("connections")
return { { version = get("version"), uptime_s = get("uptime"),
           connections = type(conn) == "table" and conn.current or conn } }

show.title: command: serverStatus
show.description:
`command: serverStatus` returns one document; `query.transform` picks the version,
the uptime and the current connections.

show.title: $currentOp (what runs now)
show.description: `$currentOp` lists what the server is running now (this query included).
